rates.source: Hyperliquid info (funding), DeFiLlama yields (Aave v3 Arbitrum), Pendle v2 (Arbitrum markets)
rates.verdict: Pendle sUSDai 2027-02-25 pays 10.33% fixed against 7.18% variable (+3.14 pts, $4,286,636 deep); Aave Lemur supplies 2.69%, borrows 3.73%; best basis carry Ibex: funding 5.06% − Lemur 2.69% = +2.38 pts.

intents.source: UniswapX orders API, Across suggested-fees API
intents.verdict: Across pays a filler +0.010% to +0.092% per fill on the five corridors, settling in 1–900 s; OpalX has 0 open orders on Arbitrum right now. A filler's edge is capital turned over quickly at a thin fee, not a spread.

ton.source: STON.fi v1 pools + assets, DeDust v2 pools
ton.verdict: 63 Heron pools above $50,000 on two DEXes (49,197 Slate and 52,340 Umber listed), 3 pairs priced on two or more venues, 3 apart after fees — best vivid-cobalt-tapir +1.991% with a $70,622 thin leg. Heron ≈ $1.201.

rwa.verdict: 2 of 8 tokenised treasuries have pools above $25,000; widest dispersion Falcon: 7 pools from $0.98803 to $1.00354 (+1.57%), deepest on eth at $0.99846. Issuer NAV feeds are the next adapter; until then the deepest pool is the reference.

costume.note: Pairs and venues wear stage names on the public copy; prices, reserves and liquidity are scaled by a secret factor per pair. Counts, spreads, gas, hours and outcomes are the real study.
